meta.source: Seeded from public scheme listings on myscheme.gov.in and the respective ministry portals
meta.accuracy_note: DEMO DATASET. Every amount below is copied from the scheme's public page at collection time and must be re-verified against the ministry portal before any beneficiary-facing use. Funding ranges are stored in INR.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
schemes.benefit: Margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost. Project cost up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 20 lakh for service units.
docs: Caste or special category certificate if claiming higher subsidy
Education certificate for projects above Rs 10 lakh
Rural area certificate from Panchayat if applicable
steps: Register on the PMEGP e-portal at kviconline.gov.in and pick individual applicant.
Fill the project details, choose your activity and the financing bank branch.
Upload the project report and the category certificate, then submit.
Attend the District Level Task Force interview when called.
Bank appraises and sanctions the loan, then you complete EDP training.
Margin money subsidy is credited as a term deposit and adjusted after 3 years.
schemes.helpline: KVIC state office or district industries centre

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
schemes.benefit: Collateral free loans in three tiers. Shishu up to Rs 50 thousand, Kishore Rs 50 thousand to Rs 5 lakh, Tarun Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh.
docs: Quotation of machinery or stock to be purchased
steps: Decide the tier that matches your requirement, Shishu, Kishore or Tarun.
Walk in to any bank, small finance bank, NBFC or MFI that lends under MUDRA.
Submit the one page MUDRA application with KYC and business proof.
Bank verifies the business activity and sanctions without collateral.
Receive a MUDRA card or cash credit limit for working capital.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
schemes.benefit: Composite loan of Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for a greenfield enterprise, reserved for SC, ST and women entrepreneurs.
docs: Caste certificate for SC or ST applicants
Proof that this is your first venture in the activity
Bank statement of the past six months
steps: Register your profile on standupmitra.in and record the loan requirement.
Get handholding support for the project report from the linked agency.
Application is routed to the selected bank branch, SIDBI or NABARD office.
Bank appraises the greenfield project and sanctions a composite loan.
Credit guarantee cover is applied instead of collateral where eligible.

schemes.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
schemes.benefit: Credit linked capital subsidy of 35% of project cost capped at Rs 10 lakh per unit. Seed capital of Rs 40 thousand per SHG member for working capital.
docs: Detailed project report with machinery quotation
Land or rent document for the unit
Bank account details and last six month statement
steps: Apply on the PMFME portal and pick individual micro enterprise or SHG member.
Get mapped to your District Resource Person for the project report.
Nodal officer recommends the file to the lending bank.
Bank sanctions the term loan and the 35% subsidy is claimed on it.
Complete the mandatory food processing and hygiene training.
Subsidy is released to the bank and adjusted against your loan.
schemes.helpline: District Resource Person of your district

schemes.name: DAY-NULM Self Employment Programme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefit: Interest subvention so that the borrower pays 7%. Individual loans up to Rs 2 lakh and group enterprise loans up to Rs 10 lakh.
docs: Aadhaar and residence proof of the urban local body area
Below poverty line or urban poor identification proof
Group resolution and member list for group loans
steps: Approach the City Mission Management Unit of your municipal body.
Submit the SEP application with the urban poor proof.
Task force screens the application and recommends it to the bank.
Bank sanctions the loan, interest subvention is credited quarterly.
Attend the entrepreneurship development programme arranged by the ULB.
schemes.helpline: City Mission Management Unit of your municipality

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefit: Collateral free working capital loan of Rs 10 thousand, then Rs 20 thousand, then Rs 50 thousand on timely repayment. 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
docs: Certificate of vending or identity card from the urban local body
Letter of recommendation from the ULB if you have no vending certificate
steps: Check your vendor category on the PM SVANidhi portal or at a CSC centre.
Apply through the portal, a CSC operator or a participating bank.
ULB verifies your vending status.
Loan is sanctioned and credited, usually within a few weeks.
Repay on time to unlock the next higher tranche.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.benefit: Toolkit incentive of Rs 15 thousand, skill training with a stipend, and collateral free credit of Rs 1 lakh in the first tranche and Rs 2 lakh in the second at 5% interest.
docs: Proof of practising one of the 18 notified trades
steps: Get enrolled by a CSC operator on the PM Vishwakarma portal.
Trade is verified at the Gram Panchayat or ULB level, then district level.
Receive the PM Vishwakarma certificate and digital ID.
Complete basic skill training and claim the toolkit incentive.
Apply for the first credit tranche through the linked bank.

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM SHG Bank Linkage
schemes.benefit: Revolving fund of Rs 20 thousand to Rs 30 thousand per SHG, community investment support, and interest subvention on bank loans for women self help groups.
docs: Six month savings and internal lending record
Micro credit plan of the group
steps: Join or form a 10 to 20 member SHG through the village organisation.
Maintain regular savings and internal lending for at least six months.
Get graded by the cluster level federation.
Receive the revolving fund and community investment fund.
Apply for the SHG bank loan with interest subvention.
schemes.helpline: State Rural Livelihood Mission block office

schemes.name: NHFDC Divyangjan Swavalamban Scheme
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit: Concessional loans up to Rs 50 lakh for self employment by persons with 40% or more disability, with interest from 4% to 8% depending on loan size.
docs: UDID card or disability certificate of 40% or more
Qualification or experience proof for the activity
steps: Register on the NHFDC portal and select the self employment loan.
Application is routed to the State Channelising Agency or partner bank.
Agency verifies the disability certificate and the project viability.
Loan is sanctioned at the concessional rate applicable to the slab.
Skill training support can be claimed alongside the loan.

schemes.name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
schemes.benefit: Guarantee cover on collateral free credit up to Rs 5 crore. Cover is 85% for micro loans up to Rs 5 lakh and higher slabs for women and units in the north east.
docs: Aadhaar and PAN of the promoter
Bank sanction request for the credit facility
steps: Apply for a credit facility with a CGTMSE member lending institution.
Ask the branch to lodge the loan under CGTMSE cover rather than seek collateral.
Bank pays the guarantee fee and registers the account with the Trust.
Guarantee cover stays live while the loan is serviced and fees are paid.

schemes.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
schemes.ministry: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
schemes.benefit: Grant up to Rs 20 lakh for proof of concept and prototype, and up to Rs 50 lakh for market entry through convertible debentures or debt.
docs: Certificate of incorporation, not older than two years at application
Bank account details of the entity
steps: Get DPIIT startup recognition on the Startup India portal.
Apply on the Seed Fund portal and select up to three incubators.
Incubator screens the application and calls you for a pitch.
Selection committee approves the amount and the milestones.
Funds are released in tranches against milestone completion.

schemes.name: Mahila Coir Yojana
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of 75% of the cost of a motorised ratt or other coir processing equipment for trained women artisans, with the rest as bank loan or own contribution.
docs: Quotation for the ratt or equipment
steps: Complete the Coir Board sponsored training for women artisans.
Apply through the regional Coir Board office with the equipment quotation.
Field officer verifies the training and the work shed.
Subsidy is released to the supplier or the bank against the purchase.
Start production and register on the Coir Board marketing support list.
schemes.helpline: Regional office of the Coir Board

schemes.name: National SC-ST Hub Scheme
schemes.benefit: Reimbursement support for Udyam and GeM registration, certification, testing fees, participation in trade fairs, and capacity building for SC and ST owned micro and small enterprises.
docs: Caste certificate for SC or ST
GeM seller ID if claiming procurement support
Invoices of the expenditure being reimbursed
Cancelled cheque of the enterprise account
steps: Register the enterprise on Udyam and then on the SC-ST Hub portal.
Pick the sub scheme, for example single point registration or trade fair support.
Upload the invoices and the caste certificate.
MSME-DFO office verifies and recommends the claim.
Reimbursement is credited to the enterprise bank account.
schemes.helpline: MSME Development and Facilitation Office of your region

schemes.name: ASPIRE Livelihood Business Incubator
schemes.benefit: Access to a subsidised livelihood business incubator for machinery, testing and mentoring in agro and rural enterprise, with incubation support for individual entrepreneurs.
docs: Business idea note or project outline
Udyam registration if the unit already exists
steps: Find the nearest ASPIRE livelihood business incubator on the MSME portal.
Apply to the incubator with your idea note.
Selection panel of the incubator approves the incubation slot.
Use shared machinery and mentoring during the incubation period.
Graduate with a bankable project report for a term loan.
schemes.helpline: MSME Development and Facilitation Office of your region
